selfHelpStops.condition: The pardon withholds firearm rights and the restoration question controls.
The prosecutor or a victim files an objection.
Immigration, licensing or firearm consequences are in play.

requiredParticipantInputQuestions.question: On what date was the pardon granted?
What does the pardon certificate say about restoration of your civil and political rights?
Does the pardon expressly exclude firearm rights from the restoration?
In which county were the charges filed?

supportingDocuments.name: Pardon certificate
supportingDocuments.obtainedFrom: Alabama Board of Pardons and Paroles
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Attach the pardon certificate to the petition. It is a filing attachment and reference document; LegalEase does not approve it.

supportingDocuments.name: Certified ALEA criminal record
supportingDocuments.howToObtain: Request a certified criminal record from ALEA.

destination.name: Criminal division of the circuit court, county where the charges were filed
destination.detail: Court-controlled with a prosecutor and victim objection window.

manualCompletionItems: The petitioner signs their own petition.
